# The Missing Meter

The Missing Meter is a research paper by Sidney Scott, The Ashby Institute.

## Canonical pages

- Full paper: https://themissingmeter.org/
- Publications index: https://themissingmeter.org/publications/
- Publication record: https://themissingmeter.org/publications/the-missing-meter/
- Materials: https://themissingmeter.org/materials/
- Machine-readable publications listing: https://themissingmeter.org/publications.json
- Final PDF: https://themissingmeter.org/downloads/The_Missing_Meter.pdf

## Current publication

- Title: The Missing Meter: What every infrastructure buildout leaves behind, and the unit AI still lacks
- Author: Sidney Scott
- Affiliation: The Ashby Institute
- Version: v1.0
- First published: 2026-07-15
- Latest revision: 2026-10-01
- Abstract: AI is the first trillion-dollar infrastructure buildout that cannot yet state, in a standard unit, what its output costs. This paper proposes the served token as a unit of account for AI inference, conditioned on a stated service-level objective and quality floor.

## Downloadable materials

- Final paper PDF
- Exhibit 1 CSV: hyperscaler capex versus inference cost
- Exhibit 2 CSV: unit cost across five infrastructure cycles
- Worked-example PDF: served-token inversion across 15 providers

The final PDF refers to additional ancillary submission materials. Those materials are not yet published on the site.
